migrations.name: 0003_oauth_policy.sql
statements:
-- Loginflare policy state is separate from Better Auth's token implementation.
-- Native authorizationCodeId identifies one grant across all refresh rotations.
-- Keep the original session ID after ordinary logout clears native token foreign keys.
-- Security revocation must close new grants before native session deletion runs.
ALTER TABLE "session" ADD COLUMN "oauthRevokedAt" TEXT

CREATE TABLE "oauthGrantPolicy" (
    "authorizationCodeId" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "clientId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "oauthClient" ("clientId") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "originalSessionId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "revokedAt" TEXT
)
CREATE INDEX "oauthGrantPolicy_userId_idx" ON "oauthGrantPolicy" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "oauthGrantPolicy_originalSessionId_idx" ON "oauthGrantPolicy" ("originalSessionId")

-- Refresh rotation does a native compare-and-set followed by a separate INSERT.
-- These guards prevent an in-flight successor from escaping a completed revocation.
-- A new grant must still have its original active session; an existing offline
-- grant may keep refreshing after that session has ended through ordinary logout.
CREATE TRIGGER "oauthRefreshToken_policy_guard" BEFORE INSERT ON "oauthRefreshToken"
WHEN NEW."authorizationCodeId" IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "user" WHERE "id" = NEW."userId" AND COALESCE("banned", 0) = 0 AND "emailVerified" = 1)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId" AND "revokedAt" IS NOT NULL)
    OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId")
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "session" WHERE "id" = NEW."sessionId" AND "userId" = NEW."userId"
            AND "oauthRevokedAt" IS NULL
            AND CASE WHEN typeof("expiresAt") IN ('integer', 'real') THEN "expiresAt" / 1000.0 ELSE unixepoch("expiresAt") END > unixepoch()))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OAUTH_GRANT_UNAVAILABLE');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "oauthAccessToken_policy_guard" BEFORE INSERT ON "oauthAccessToken"
WHEN NEW."authorizationCodeId" IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "user" WHERE "id" = NEW."userId" AND COALESCE("banned", 0) = 0 AND "emailVerified" = 1)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId" AND "revokedAt" IS NOT NULL)
    OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId")
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "session" WHERE "id" = NEW."sessionId" AND "userId" = NEW."userId"
            AND "oauthRevokedAt" IS NULL
            AND CASE WHEN typeof("expiresAt") IN ('integer', 'real') THEN "expiresAt" / 1000.0 ELSE unixepoch("expiresAt") END > unixepoch()))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OAUTH_GRANT_UNAVAILABLE');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "oauthRefreshToken_policy_register" AFTER INSERT ON "oauthRefreshToken"
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId")
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO "oauthGrantPolicy" ("authorizationCodeId", "userId", "clientId", "originalSessionId")
        VALUES (NEW."authorizationCodeId", NEW."userId", NEW."clientId", NEW."sessionId");
END

CREATE TRIGGER "oauthAccessToken_policy_register" AFTER INSERT ON "oauthAccessToken"
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId")
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO "oauthGrantPolicy" ("authorizationCodeId", "userId", "clientId", "originalSessionId")
        VALUES (NEW."authorizationCodeId", NEW."userId", NEW."clientId", NEW."sessionId");
END

CREATE TRIGGER "oauthGrantPolicy_revoke_tokens" AFTER UPDATE OF "revokedAt" ON "oauthGrantPolicy"
WHEN NEW."revokedAt" IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE "oauthRefreshToken" SET "revoked" = NEW."revokedAt"
        WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId" AND "revoked" IS NULL;
    UPDATE "oauthAccessToken" SET "revoked" = NEW."revokedAt"
        WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId" AND "revoked" IS NULL;
END

-- The session marker blocks first grants while this trigger revokes existing ones.
-- Both changes commit together; ordinary logout never sets the marker.
CREATE TRIGGER "session_revoke_oauth_grants" AFTER UPDATE OF "oauthRevokedAt" ON "session"
WHEN NEW."oauthRevokedAt" IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE "oauthGrantPolicy" SET "revokedAt" = NEW."oauthRevokedAt"
        WHERE "originalSessionId" = NEW."id" AND "revokedAt" IS NULL;
END

-- Account suspension is an authorization boundary, including offline grants.
-- The flag and all revocations commit together, even if later session cleanup fails.
CREATE TRIGGER "user_suspend_oauth_grants" AFTER UPDATE OF "banned" ON "user"
WHEN NEW."banned" = 1
BEGIN
    UPDATE "session" SET "oauthRevokedAt" = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
        WHERE "userId" = NEW."id" AND "oauthRevokedAt" IS NULL;
    UPDATE "oauthGrantPolicy" SET "revokedAt" = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
        WHERE "userId" = NEW."id" AND "revokedAt" IS NULL;
END

statements:
-- user.email remains Better Auth's sole email login identifier. This registry
-- reserves both primary and auxiliary addresses with one case-insensitive key.
CREATE TABLE "userEmail" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "email" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE UNIQUE,
    "verified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("verified" IN (0, 1)),
    "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK ("email" = lower(trim("email")))
)
CREATE INDEX "userEmail_userId_idx" ON "userEmail" ("userId")

INSERT INTO "userEmail" ("id", "userId", "email", "verified", "createdAt")
    SELECT 'primary:' || "id", "id", lower("email"), "emailVerified",
        CAST(unixepoch('now') * 1000 AS INTEGER) FROM "user"

CREATE TRIGGER "userEmail_limit_guard" BEFORE INSERT ON "userEmail"
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "userEmail" WHERE "email" = NEW."email")
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "userEmail" WHERE "userId" = NEW."userId") >= 10
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'EMAIL_LIMIT_REACHED');
END

CREATE TABLE "emailChallenge" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "emailId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "userEmail" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("purpose" IN ('verify', 'recovery')),
    "codeHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "expiresAt" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX "emailChallenge_userId_idx" ON "emailChallenge" ("userId")

-- Triggers run in the native write's transaction, including sign-up and native
-- verification. No asynchronous after-hook can leave an unreserved main email.
CREATE TRIGGER "user_email_register" AFTER INSERT ON "user"
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO "userEmail" ("id", "userId", "email", "verified", "createdAt")
        VALUES ('primary:' || NEW."id", NEW."id", lower(NEW."email"), NEW."emailVerified", CAST(unixepoch('now') * 1000 AS INTEGER));
END

CREATE TRIGGER "user_email_owner_guard" BEFORE UPDATE OF "email" ON "user"
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "userEmail" WHERE "email" = lower(NEW."email") AND "userId" <> NEW."id")
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "user_email_verified_target_guard" BEFORE UPDATE OF "email" ON "user"
WHEN lower(NEW."email") <> lower(OLD."email") AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "userEmail" WHERE "email" = lower(NEW."email") AND "userId" = NEW."id" AND "verified" = 1
)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "user_email_sync" AFTER UPDATE OF "email", "emailVerified" ON "user"
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO "userEmail" ("id", "userId", "email", "verified", "createdAt")
        VALUES ('email:' || lower(hex(randomblob(16))), NEW."id", lower(NEW."email"), NEW."emailVerified", CAST(unixepoch('now') * 1000 AS INTEGER))
        ON CONFLICT ("email") DO UPDATE SET "verified" = NEW."emailVerified";
END

CREATE TRIGGER "userEmail_primary_delete_guard" BEFORE DELETE ON "userEmail"
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "user" WHERE "id" = OLD."userId" AND "email" = OLD."email" COLLATE NOCASE)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'PRIMARY_EMAIL_REQUIRED');
END

CREATE TRIGGER "userEmail_address_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OF "userId", "email" ON "userEmail"
WHEN NEW."userId" <> OLD."userId" OR NEW."email" <> OLD."email"
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'EMAIL_ADDRESS_IMMUTABLE');
END

-- Security changes invalidate every outstanding recovery proof, including a
-- short-lived native reset ticket already handed to the password form.
CREATE TRIGGER "user_email_invalidate_proofs" AFTER UPDATE OF "email", "banned" ON "user"
WHEN NEW."email" <> OLD."email" OR COALESCE(NEW."banned", 0) <> COALESCE(OLD."banned", 0)
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM "emailChallenge" WHERE "userId" = NEW."id";
    DELETE FROM "verification" WHERE "value" = NEW."id" AND "identifier" LIKE 'reset-password:%';
END

CREATE TRIGGER "userEmail_remove_invalidate_proofs" AFTER DELETE ON "userEmail"
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM "verification" WHERE "value" = OLD."userId" AND "identifier" LIKE 'reset-password:%';
END

CREATE TRIGGER "oauthClient_management_create" BEFORE INSERT ON "oauthClient"

BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM "user" u JOIN "session" s ON s."userId" = u."id"
            WHERE u."id" = NEW."managementUserId" AND s."id" = NEW."managementSessionId"
            AND u."emailVerified" = 1 AND coalesce(u."banned", 0) = 0 AND s."oauthRevokedAt" IS NULL
            AND s."expiresAt" > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
            AND ((NEW."managementAdministrator" = 1 AND u."role" = 'admin' AND NEW."ownerId" IS NULL)
                OR (NEW."managementAdministrator" = 0 AND NEW."ownerId" = u."id"))
        ) OR (NEW."ownerId" IS NULL AND NEW."managementUserId" IS NULL
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "machineWrite" WHERE "scope" = 'management:applications:write'))
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'APPLICATION_ACCESS_REVOKED') END;
    SELECT CASE WHEN NEW."ownerDisabled" <> 0 OR NEW."adminSuspended" <> 0 OR coalesce(NEW."disabled", 0) <> 0
        THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'APPLICATION_STATUS_CONFLICT') END;
END

BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NEW."managementAdministrator" = 0 AND OLD."adminSuspended" = 1
        THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'APPLICATION_SUSPENDED') END;
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM "user" u JOIN "session" s ON s."userId" = u."id"
            WHERE u."id" = NEW."managementUserId" AND s."id" = NEW."managementSessionId"
            AND u."emailVerified" = 1 AND coalesce(u."banned", 0) = 0 AND s."oauthRevokedAt" IS NULL
            AND s."expiresAt" > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
            AND ((NEW."managementAdministrator" = 1 AND u."role" = 'admin' AND NEW."ownerDisabled" = OLD."ownerDisabled")
                OR (NEW."managementAdministrator" = 0 AND OLD."ownerId" = u."id" AND NEW."adminSuspended" = OLD."adminSuspended"))
        ) OR (NEW."managementUserId" IS NULL AND NEW."ownerDisabled" = OLD."ownerDisabled"
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "machineWrite" WHERE "scope" IN ('management:applications:write', 'management:resources:write')))
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'APPLICATION_ACCESS_REVOKED') END;
    SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(NEW."disabled", 0) <> (NEW."ownerDisabled" OR NEW."adminSuspended")
        THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'APPLICATION_STATUS_CONFLICT') END;
END

    ON CONFLICT ("userId", "clientId") DO UPDATE SET "scopes" = excluded."scopes", "createdAt" = excluded."createdAt";
    INSERT INTO "oauthAccountApplication" ("userId", "clientId", "scopes", "createdAt")
    SELECT c."userId", c."clientId",
        (SELECT json_group_array("value") FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT j."value" FROM "oauthConsent" other, json_each(other."scopes") j
            WHERE other."userId" = NEW."userId" AND other."clientId" = NEW."clientId" ORDER BY j."value"
        )), max(coalesce(c."updatedAt", c."createdAt"))
    FROM "oauthConsent" c WHERE c."userId" = NEW."userId" AND c."clientId" = NEW."clientId"
    GROUP BY c."userId", c."clientId"
    ON CONFLICT ("userId", "clientId") DO UPDATE SET "scopes" = excluded."scopes", "createdAt" = excluded."createdAt";
END

    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId"
        AND ("revokedAt" IS NOT NULL OR "userId" <> NEW."userId" OR "clientId" <> NEW."clientId"))
    OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId" AND "activatedAt" IS NOT NULL)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "session" WHERE "id" = coalesce(NEW."sessionId",
            (SELECT "originalSessionId" FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId"))
            AND "userId" = NEW."userId" AND "oauthRevokedAt" IS NULL AND "expiresAt" > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OAUTH_GRANT_UNAVAILABLE');
END

    VALUES (NEW."authorizationCodeId", NEW."userId", NEW."clientId", coalesce(NEW."sessionId",
        (SELECT "originalSessionId" FROM "oauthGrantPolicy" WHERE "authorizationCodeId" = NEW."authorizationCodeId")),
        NEW."expiresAt", NEW."createdAt")

END

        CASE WHEN json_type(NEW."value", '$.query.resource') = 'array' THEN json_extract(NEW."value", '$.query.resource')

    );
END

objects.name: verification_oauth_code_guard

CREATE TRIGGER "verification_oauth_code_guard" BEFORE INSERT ON "verification"
WHEN CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW."value") THEN json_extract(NEW."value", '$.type') END = 'authorization_code'
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM "session" s JOIN "user" u ON u."id" = s."userId"
        JOIN "oauthClient" a ON a."clientId" = json_extract(NEW."value", '$.query.client_id')
        WHERE s."id" = json_extract(NEW."value", '$.sessionId')
            AND s."userId" = json_extract(NEW."value", '$.userId')
            AND s."oauthRevokedAt" IS NULL AND s."expiresAt" > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
            AND u."emailVerified" = 1 AND coalesce(u."banned", 0) = 0 AND coalesce(a."disabled", 0) = 0
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oauthConsent" c WHERE c."userId" = s."userId" AND c."clientId" = a."clientId")
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM json_each('[' || replace(json_quote(trim(json_extract(NEW."value", '$.query.scope'))), ' ', '","') || ']') requested
                WHERE requested."value" <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM "oauthConsent" c, json_each(c."scopes") allowed
                    WHERE c."userId" = s."userId" AND c."clientId" = a."clientId" AND allowed."value" = requested."value"
                )
            )
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'OAUTH_GRANT_UNAVAILABLE') END;
END

END
